c74object.name: evi.logsmooth~
c74object.description: A simple and extremely efficient ramp generator with logarithmic curve and ramp time specified in milliseconds.

inlet.description: Can take signal or float or int values to pass through the smoother.
Amount of time the value takes to reach it's destination. evi.logsmooth~ is logarithmic and does not reach it's destination exactly.

outlet.description: Smoothed output ramp, or target value if ramp is complete.

objarg.name: initial
objarg.description: Set the initial value of the output

method.name: int
method.description: In the left inlet, the destination value. In the right inlet, smoothing time in ms.

method.name: float
method.description: In the left inlet, the destination value. In the right inlet, smoothing time in ms.

method.name: clear
method.description: This clears the state of the filter. This should never be needed :-)

method.name: signal
method.description: In the left inlet, the destination value. In the right inlet, smoothing time in ms.

attribute.name: time
attribute.description: The ramp time in ms. Because evi.logsmooth~ is an inexact smoother, the destination cannot be guaranteed to reach it's value exactly in the allotted time.
